'''Tanta Aurek''' was the [[Star/Legends|sun]] of the [[Tanta Aurek system/Legends|Tanta Aurek system]]<ref name="gazetteer" /> in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="gazetteer-map" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="outersec" /> The name of the star and the system derived from the fact that it and the sun of the [[Tanta Besh system/Legends|Tanta Besh system]], [[Tanta Besh]] appeared to form a double star in the sky of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obica]]. It was orbited by the planet [[Scelepas]].<ref name="gazetteer-map" />
